description: Every organization member's access in this project Every organization member's access in this project. GET /api/organizations/{organization_id}/projects/{id}/access_control_members/
context:
GET /api/organizations/{organization_id}/projects/{id}/access_control_members/
Every organization member's access in this project. For the project and for each resource type, the response gives the member's own rule and the level that is enforced. It also says where the enforced level comes from: the member's rule, a role's rule, the project default, or full access as an organization admin. Pass `member_id` for one member.
Required: id (path) — A unique value identifying this project.; organization_id (path) — ID of the organization you're trying to access. To find the ID of the organization, make a call to /api/organizations/.
Optional: member_id (query) — Narrow the list to one organization membership id.
